rule: Each production Worker has ONE canonical code publisher. Every workflow that can change a Worker (code, rollback, secrets or settings) runs inside that Worker's single concurrency group, so changes are serialized. A workflow with a publish command that is not listed here fails tests/publisher-inventory.test.mjs.

owner_authorized_serialization.mercadopago-production-token-rotate.yml: Written owner authorization: "AUTORIZO SERIALIZAR mercadopago-production-token-rotate.yml NO GRUPO deploy-zevanory". Only the concurrency block changed (group deploy-zevanory, cancel-in-progress false, queue max, workflow level, same as the other publishers); recoverability analysis in docs/ops/ROTACAO_MERCADOPAGO.md section 1.1.

zevanory-public-router.t1_unchanged: Single publisher, already in its own group. Left byte-identical so merging T1 does not redeploy the router. Known residual risk (pre-existing): its pull-request runs share the deploy group, so with the default queue a PR run can replace a pending deploy; fix (PR-separated group + queue: max + guard with --tag) in a follow-up the owner schedules.

zevanory-product-control-portable.guard: scripts/deploy/promotion_guard.py (cloudflare tag + version.json) inside the canonical workflow; forward promotion refused when the source cannot be certified by both sources

config_publisher_notes.owner-oauth-key-bootstrap.yml: Config only (one secret, OWNER_OAUTH_BRIDGE_SECRET); workflow_dispatch with typed BOOTSTRAP; one-time and fail-closed (refuses if the secret exists); same queue. Never publishes code.

requester_notes.t2-exact-control-worker-promotion.yml: Scheduled reconciler. No build, no secret, no deploy, no Cloudflare write: read-only guard decision, then workflow_dispatch of the canonical publisher with skip_if_live=true (permissions: actions: write only).

exceptions.rollback: Single documented backwards path inside the canonical workflow itself (#796/#797): workflow_dispatch with allow_backwards, actor == repository owner, rollback_reason >= 20 chars, audit artifact retained 90 days, same queue, same publish recipe, post-promotion verification. Limitation: the actor check cannot distinguish the owner from an agent using the owner's identity (see ops/t1-activation.md E).

giro-whatsapp-bridge.note: Worker giro-whatsapp-bridge is NOT present in the Cloudflare account (workers list 13/10/2026). whatsapp-broker-protocol-v2.yml patches it via the API and fails reading it (exit 22, run on PR #799); left unchanged and listed under unserialized_known.

external_repositories.arbmsistone-lab/zevanory-product-control: must not publish production; the panel is published only by zpc-control-worker-deploy.yml in this repository

unserialized_known.whatsapp-broker-protocol-v2.yml: target Worker absent from the account; patcher fails before any write
unserialized_known.mercadopago-exact-sha-recovery.yml: financial workflow: changes need the owner's written authorization
unserialized_known.financial-e2e-stripe.yml: financial workflow: changes need the owner's written authorization

rollback_policy: A deliberate rollback is a git revert merged by the owner: a FORWARD promotion whose authorisation trail is the reviewed pull request. promotion_guard.py has no backwards path. Automatic recovery inside a failed release (central wrangler rollback, sales snapshot restore) only returns to the version that was live before that same run; the sales release never deletes the production script.
recovery_when_production_unreadable: Not automatic: the guard refuses. The owner dispatches the canonical workflow after confirming the live version manually (Cloudflare dashboard) or after restoring the readback endpoint; the run is recorded.
credentials: All 19 publishing workflows use the same account-wide tokens (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN / CLOUDFLARE_PUBLIC_OWNER_API_TOKEN), so credential-level exclusivity does not exist today. Cloudflare supports account-owned API tokens scoped to Specified Workers with the Editor role (changelog 2026-09-15). Target: one token per Worker held only by that Worker's publishers, then revoke the shared tokens. Owner action.
